title: Collectables - Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Guide
subtitle: How to start {quest} in Burning Springs, how the hand-ins to Bodhi work, and what you get for them.

sections.title: Finding Them
sections.html:
{finding_sentence}

  • Listen for them. Every briefcase makes a radar-like beeping sound that gets louder the closer you get.
    You can turn it up in Settings › Audio › Effects.
  • Look for the light. At night, or in dark places, a bright red light near the handle makes them easier to spot.
  • One per character. Once you pick one up, it won't respawn for that character.
  • They're yours only. {item_name} can't be dropped, traded or sold.
  • Track the challenge. Go to Menu › Challenges › Burning Springs › Find your first piece of Abraxodyne Intel and press Track.
  • Where they go. A briefcase goes into your Pip-Boy as {item_name} in the Misc tab, and stays there until you hand it in to Bodhi.
  • XP. Each briefcase is worth a base of 10 XP, and each Abraxodyne Cache a base of 50 XP.

sections.title: How to Start {quest}
sections.html:
There are two ways to start the quest.

Option 1 – Pick up any Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase

A note pops up: the briefcase has a label on the back that reads "If found, return to Abraxodyne Chemical Regulatory Compliance Office, Athens, OH." {quest} starts straight away, with the objective Investigate Abraxodyne Chemical’s Legal Office.

{img:questline-briefcase-message}

OR

Option 2 – Go to Athens

Go to the Abraxodyne Chemical Legal Office in Athens and talk to Bodhi.

{img:questline-athens-legal-office}

sections.title: {quest} Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Go to the Legal Office in Athens

The quest sends you to Abraxodyne Chemical’s Legal Office in Athens. Follow the quest marker and enter through the green door.

{img:questline-legal-office-map}

Step 2 – Speak to Bodhi

Inside is an NPC named Bodhi. He asks for briefcases in return for lore holotapes.

{img:questline-speak-to-bodhi}

Dialogue check [Ghoul] – if you are a Ghoul (and not disguised), Bodhi reacts to it and you get three Ghoul-only replies. They only change the conversation.

Step 3 – Collect briefcases

The objective is now Collect Abraxodyne intel briefcases. Each batch needs a set number of briefcases: see Handing In Briefcases to Bodhi below.

After hand-ins {cache_batches}, Bodhi finds a keycode and coordinates in the briefcases and gives you the optional objective Find and loot an Abraxodyne Cache. He marks the cache on your map: see the Cache Locations page.

{img:questline-collect-intel}

Step 4 – Hand them in to Bodhi

Once you have the batch, the objective changes to Return briefcases to Bodhi. Hand them in, then go out for the next batch. After the last of the {batch_count} batches, {quest} isn’t over yet: see The Finale below (spoilers).

{img:questline-return-to-bodhi}

sections.title: Handing In Briefcases to Bodhi
sections.html:
Take your briefcases to Bodhi at Abraxodyne Chemical’s Legal Office in Athens. He takes them in {batch_count} hand-ins and gives you a lore holotape for each one:

{batch_table}

That is {quest_total} briefcases for the whole quest. You can turn them in as you go or save them up and hand them in all at once: the game still counts the total and gives you a holotape for every hand-in your briefcases cover.

sections.title: Quest Rewards
sections.html:
• Finishing {quest} pays {caps} caps, {xp} XP, {plan} and a Burning Springs loot roll.
  • Each hand-in gives you one of the {batch_count} Abraxodyne Tapes.
  • Each briefcase you pick up is worth a base of 10 XP.
  • The three Abraxodyne Caches give more rewards: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Cache Locations 1 - 3.

Every reward, with tick boxes: Abraxodyne Intel Briefcase Reward Checklist.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Will I still receive the lifetime rewards on a Custom World?

Yes, but the rewards will not carry over to Adventure mode. If you switch to Adventure, the challenges will appear as 0, and you will need to collect all the briefcases again.

Do I have to start the questline to unlock all the rewards?

Yes and No. You don’t need to start the questline to unlock the lifetime challenge rewards and weapons.

There are 148 briefcase spawns in the world, and the final lifetime reward, the Prototype ABX03, unlocks at 145 collected. That means you can earn every lifetime challenge reward and weapon from world spawns alone, without the caches. The caches grant three bonus briefcases each (currently bugged) and their keycodes only come from Dirty Laundry hand-ins {cache_batches}, so they are optional for the rewards.

There’s also a separate lifetime challenge for completing the questline itself, so whether you do it depends on whether you want those additional rewards.

sections.title: The Finale
sections.html:
Bodhi’s daughter Amrita worked for Abraxodyne Chemical before the war. Once you have handed in the last batch, the briefcases have turned up an address in Athens that could lead to answers about her murder.

Step 1 – Investigate the apartment

The objective is Investigate the apartment. Follow the quest marker to the address in Athens. Inside is a Ghoul who wants you out of his apartment. Ask him about the hitman that was sent here, or tell him you’re not going anywhere until you find out what happened to Amrita, and he admits it: he sat on Abraxodyne Chemical’s board, and when Amrita kept prying he had her taken care of.

Dialogue check [Ghoul] – if you are a Ghoul, he greets you as a fellow Ghoul. It only changes his words.

Step 2 – Deal with the Exec

The objective is Kill the Exec. He says he only did it to protect his wife and daughter, and offers you caps to spare him. You have three choices:

  • [Attack] – "Forget your caps, you deserve a bullet." You kill him.
  • "You’ve got yourself a deal." You take his caps and he leaves town.
  • "Keep your caps. I can see now you were just playing the hand you were dealt." No caps, and he leaves town.

Step 3 – Return to Bodhi

The objective is now Return to Bodhi. What you can tell him depends on what you did:

  • You killed him – "I killed him, but only to get justice for Amrita." or "I put him down, like the dog that he is." Bodhi thanks you.
  • You let him go – "I let him go. He was just trying to protect his own family." or "I banished him from Athens and told him never to return." Bodhi is angry he got off so lightly.
  • [LIE] – "I’m sorry, but the place was empty when I got there." Bodhi believes the trail has gone cold.
